name: Nexus
tagline: One agent workflow that plans and runs every part of a student club event.
problem: Running events spans departments, apps and asynchronous tasks.
solution: An AI workflow that understands event components, timelines and responsibilities and acts on them, with a dashboard and chat.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask for an event plan and see tasks assigned across teams.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Vultr” among 169 submissions.
Built by members of the club it serves, with their testimonials.

lessons: Real users' quotes from your own community add credibility.
